scale: 0-100 when evaluable; null/UNKNOWN when not evaluable

category_normalization.description: Use the leading source/standardized code before explanatory text. IUCN/regional-red-list codes and Article 17 codes remain separate systems.
category_normalization.REW: Regional extinction/extinction in the wild in the source jurisdiction; maximum source-territory severity, still multiplied by territorial relevance.

aggregation.description: After latest-within-logical-unit selection, score = 0.8*highest weighted assessment + 0.2*mean(up to three highest distinct-unit weighted assessments).

conflict_policy.same_unit_same_version_incompatible_cate: UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT; preserve all; scoring projection uses precautionary maximum evaluable severity

rationale.territory: Regional and Spanish evidence has highest relevance for a La Rioja collection programme; continental/global is supportive; unrelated European jurisdictions are lower weight.
rationale.time: Historical evidence is attenuated rather than discarded.
rationale.DD: Data Deficient is not low risk and receives a precautionary intermediate value.
rationale.REW: Regional extinction is maximum severity within that jurisdiction but low territorial relevance prevents an unrelated-country regional extinction from dominating La Rioja urgency.
rationale.article_17: Article 17 conservation status is transformed separately from IUCN extinction-risk categories.
